operations.name: demean
operations.scope: each continuous run after event capture and before resampling

operations.name: resample_polyphase_with_events
operations.expected_mne_call: raw.resample(160, method="polyphase", window=("kaiser", 5.0), pad="reflect", events=events, n_jobs=1)

operations.name: bandpass_sos_zero_phase
operations.padlen_rule: 3 * (2 * n_sos + 1 - min(zero_count_at_origin, pole_count_at_origin)); evaluates to 27 for frozen 4th-order 8-32 Hz bandpass at 160 Hz
